title_en: Application for On-Campus Scholarships for Spring 2027
summary: Undergraduate and graduate students due to register for Spring 2027 who wish to receive on-campus scholarships, international students, and students newly eligible for the national merit or North Korean defector scholarships must apply. Applications are made by completing the application form on MySNU (마이스누) between Monday, 23 November 2026 and 18:00 on Friday, 11 December 2026. Students who do not apply cannot receive on-campus or Development Foundation scholarships, and late applications are not accepted.
applies_to: Undergraduate and graduate students due to register (등록대상자) for Spring 2027 who wish to receive on-campus scholarships for Spring 2027; international students; and students who have newly become eligible for the national merit (국가유공) or North Korean defector (북한이탈) scholarships. Application is mandatory for anyone who wishes to receive an on-campus or Development Foundation scholarship.

dates.what: Application period for Spring 2027 on-campus scholarships (closes at 18:00 on the final day)

conditions: Students who do not apply cannot receive any on-campus or Development Foundation (발전재단) scholarship.
Additional (late) applications are not accepted after the application period closes.
Applications must be made by completing the application form on MySNU (마이스누).
steps: Read the attached guide that applies to you: the undergraduate guide (2027학년도 1학기 학부생 교내장학금 신청 안내.hwp) or the graduate guide (2027학년도 1학기 대학원생 교내장학금 신청 안내.hwp). The contents of these attachments were not read for this translation.

Note the attached Scholarship Selection Application Form (장학선정신청서); the notice does not state how it is to be used, so check the attached guides or contact the department office (contact details are in the original notice).
Log in to MySNU (마이스누) and complete the scholarship application form between 23 November 2026 and 18:00 on 11 December 2026.
translation:
Application for On-Campus Scholarships for Spring 2027 (2027학년도 1학기 교내장학금 신청 안내)

Please note the following regarding applications for on-campus scholarships for Spring 2027.

A. Eligible applicants: undergraduate and graduate students due to register (등록대상자) for Spring 2027 who wish to receive an on-campus scholarship for Spring 2027; international students; and students who have newly become eligible for the national merit (국가유공) or North Korean defector (북한이탈) scholarships.

B. Application period: Monday, 23 November 2026 to Friday, 11 December 2026, 18:00.
※ Students who do not apply cannot receive on-campus or Development Foundation (발전재단) scholarships, so you must apply. (Additional applications are not accepted.)

C. How to apply: complete the application form on MySNU (마이스누).

Attachments (3) [the contents of the attachments were not read for this translation]:
1. 2027학년도 1학기 학부생 교내장학금 신청 안내.hwp (Spring 2027 On-Campus Scholarship Application Guide for Undergraduates) (74 KB)
2. 2027학년도 1학기 대학원생 교내장학금 신청 안내.hwp (Spring 2027 On-Campus Scholarship Application Guide for Graduate Students) (69 KB)
3-1. 2027학년도 1학기 장학선정신청서.hwp (Spring 2027 Scholarship Selection Application Form) (28 KB)
